items.title: 30 States Are Now Suing Dollar General Over Prices at the Register
items.summary: A dollar store lives on one promise: the shelf tag matches the register. As more states pile onto the FTC's case, the real threat may not be a fine but a court order reaching into every store's daily routines.

items.title: Ten more states join FTC pricing lawsuit against Dollar General
items.summary: Investing.com -- Ten additional states have joined a Federal Trade Commission lawsuit accusing Dollar General Corporation (NYSE: DG) of charging shoppers more at checkout than the prices displayed on shelves, price tags and advertisements.
